title: Advanced Emotional Intelligence and Professional Communications
description: Emotional intelligence (EI) is arguably the most important key to success in one’s career and personal life. In this course, students will apply actionable strategies for deepening their own emotional intelligence, improving personal and professional relationships, and employing sound decision-making strategies in the field of arts administration. Students will assess their own awareness and management of emotional responses; practice authentic and active empathy; collaborate in teams; and explore the practice of making (and taking accountability for) impactful decisions.
prerequisites: For graduate students, no prerequisite courses are required. Undergraduate students need senior status and need permission from instructor
